```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(googledrive)
library(lubridate)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(fluxfinder)

RAW_DIR <- "Raw_Data/"

MSMT_LENGTH <- 90

RAW_DIR <- "Raw_Data/"
PROCESSED_DIR <- "Processed_Data"

# Metadata file produced by script 1
PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, 
                                  "SoilFluxes_8100_Metadata_processed_final.parquet")
# Clock offset files produced by script 2
PLOT_OFFSET_FILE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "offsets-plot-specific.csv")
COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "offsets-collar-specific.csv")

# The output of this script: computed fluxes
TEMP_FLUX_DIR <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "temporary_fluxes")

COLLAR_AREA <- (20 / 2) ^ 2 * pi / (100 * 100) # m2
```


```{r log-setup}
# Set up logs
start_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d%H%M")
LOG_FOLDER <- file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "logs")
ROW_LOG <- file.path(LOG_FOLDER, paste0("rows_", start_time, ".log"))
DATE_LOG <- file.path(LOG_FOLDER, paste0("dates_", start_time, ".log"))

# Logging functions
log_date <- function(date, n_metadata_rows, n_obs, 
                     offsets_available, n_flux_success, 
                     note = "") {
    cat(as.character(date), n_metadata_rows, n_obs, offsets_available, 
        n_flux_success, note,
        sep = ",", file = DATE_LOG, append = TRUE)
    cat("\n", file = DATE_LOG, append = TRUE)
}
# Write header row; use formals() to get the names of the columns being
# written so we don't have to change this if the function arguments change
#do.call("log_date", as.list(names(formals(log_date))))
cat("date,n_metadata_rows,n_obs,offsets_available,n_flux_success,note\n", 
    file = DATE_LOG)

log_row <- function(metadata_row, date, plot, time_start, offset, n_obs, 
                    co2_flux_success, ch4_flux_success, 
                    note = "") {
    cat(metadata_row, as.character(date), plot, time_start, offset, n_obs, 
        co2_flux_success, ch4_flux_success, note,
        sep = ",", file = ROW_LOG, append = TRUE)
    cat("\n", file = ROW_LOG, append = TRUE)
}
# Write header row
#do.call("log_row", as.list(names(formals(log_row))))
cat("metadata_row,date,plot,time_start,offset,n_obs,co2_flux_success,ch4_flux_success,note\n",
    file = ROW_LOG)
```

## Load metadata

```{r load-metadata}
message("Reading ", basename(PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL))
read_parquet(PROCESSED_FILE_FINAL) |> 
    mutate(start_time = ymd_hms(start_time, tz = "EST"),
           end_time = ymd_hms(end_time, tz = "EST"),
           Vtotal = as.numeric(Vtotal)) ->
    md_all
message("\tMetadata file is ", nrow(md_all), " x ", ncol(md_all))
message("\tRemoving empty dates")
md_all |> 
    mutate(Date = date(start_time)) |> 
    filter(!is.na(Date)) ->
    md_all
message("Metadata file is ", nrow(md_all), " x ", ncol(md_all))
message("\tDate range: ", min(md_all$Date), " to ", max(md_all$Date))

message("Reading ", PLOT_OFFSET_FILE)
plot_offsets <- read_csv(PLOT_OFFSET_FILE, col_types = "Dcdc")
message("\tPlot offset file is ", nrow(plot_offsets), " x ", ncol(plot_offsets))

if(file.exists(COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE)) {
    message("Reading ", COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE)
    collar_offsets <- read_csv(COLLAR_OFFSET_FILE, col_types = "Dcd")
    message("\tCollar offset file is ", nrow(collar_offsets), " x ", ncol(collar_offsets))
} else {
    message("No collar offset file")
    collar_offsets <- tibble(Date = Date(0), label = character(0), collar_offset = NA_real_)
}

```

# Load weather data

```{r weather-data}
wx_files <- list.files("weather_data/", 
                       pattern = "GCW_W_[0-9]{4}_wx-tempavg15_L2.*.parquet$", 
                       full.names = TRUE)
wx_data <- list()
for(f in wx_files) {
    message("Reading ", basename(f))
    read_parquet(f) |>
        mutate(TIMESTAMP = force_tz(TIMESTAMP, tzone = "EST")) |> 
        group_by(Site, Plot, TIMESTAMP) |> 
        summarise(Value_MAC = mean(Value_MAC), .groups = "drop") ->
        x
    
    wx_data[[unique(year(x$TIMESTAMP))]] <- x
}
```

# Data matching and flux computation

```{r compute_fluxes}
dates_to_process <- unique(md_all$Date)
# TESTING ONLY -- do just one date
# Comment this out for real use!
dates_to_process <- ymd("2024-08-09") 

for(i in seq_along(dates_to_process)) {
    d <- dates_to_process[i]
    message(i, "/", length(dates_to_process), ": ", d)
    md_all |> 
        filter(Date == d) ->
        md_this
    message("\t", nrow(md_this), " fluxes")
    
    # Read the day-specific file prepared by script 1
    li7810file <- file.path(RAW_DIR, paste0("LI7810_", gsub("-", "", d), ".parquet"))
    if(file.exists(li7810file)) {
        li7810dat <- read_parquet(li7810file)
        li7810dat$TIMESTAMP <- force_tz(li7810dat$TIMESTAMP, "EST")
    } else {
        message("\tno LI7810 file for this date")
        log_date(date = d, n_metadata_rows = nrow(md_this),
                 n_obs = 0, 
                 offsets_available = NA, n_flux_success = 0,
                note = "No LI7810 file for this date")
        next
    }
    message("\tconcentration data file is ", 
            nrow(li7810dat), " x ", ncol(li7810dat))
    message("\tconcentration data timestamp range is ", 
            paste(range(li7810dat$TIMESTAMP), collapse = " to "))
    
    # Get offset information and check for anything missing
    md_this |> 
        left_join(plot_offsets, by = c("Plot", "Date"), 
                  relationship = "many-to-one")|> 
        left_join(collar_offsets, by = c("Date", "label"), 
                  relationship = "many-to-one") |> 
        mutate(final_clock_offset = if_else(is.na(collar_offset), 
                                            Clock_offset, collar_offset),
               Flux_CO2 = NA_real_, Flux_CH4 = NA_real_, wx_tair = NA_real_) -> 
        md_this_offsets
    
    if(any(is.na(md_this_offsets$final_clock_offset))) {
        md_this_offsets |> 
            filter(is.na(final_clock_offset)) |> 
            pull(Plot) |> 
            unique() -> 
            missing_plots
        message("\tmissing clock offset information--see log")
        log_date(date = d, n_metadata_rows = nrow(md_this),
                 n_obs = nrow(li7810dat), 
                 offsets_available = FALSE, n_flux_success = 0,
                note = paste("No clock offset for plots", 
                             paste(missing_plots, collapse = " ")))
        next
    }
    
    message("\tloading air temperature data")
    wx_thisyear <- wx_data[[year(d)]]
    if(is.null(wx_thisyear)) {
        message("\tno tair data available for this year")
        log_date(date = d, n_metadata_rows = nrow(md_this),
                 n_obs = nrow(li7810dat), 
                 offsets_available = TRUE, n_flux_success = 0,
                note = "No tair data available for this year")
        next
    }
    
    co2_fluxes <- list()
    ch4_fluxes <- list()
    success_count <- 0
    for(msmt in seq_len(nrow(md_this_offsets))) {
        this_mdrow <- md_this_offsets$metadata_row[msmt]
        this_start <- md_this_offsets$start_time[msmt]
        this_offset <- md_this_offsets$final_clock_offset[msmt]
        this_plot <- md_this_offsets$Plot[msmt]
        this_vol <- md_this_offsets$Vtotal[msmt] / 100 ^ 3 # cm3 to m3
        this_pressure <- md_this_offsets$Pressure[msmt] * 1000 # kPa to Pa
        
        # Find the air temperature corresponding to these data
        this_tair <- wx_thisyear$Value_MAC[which.min(abs(this_start - wx_thisyear$TIMESTAMP))]
        
        # Isolate, based on the clock offsets for this day and plot, 
        # the LI-7810 concentration data for this row of the metadata
        # table (i.e., for this label=collar and plot)
        suppressMessages({
            li7810dat |> 
                filter(TIMESTAMP >= this_start + this_offset, 
                       TIMESTAMP <= this_start + this_offset + MSMT_LENGTH,
                       Plot == this_plot) |>  
                # convert gas concentrations to µmol (CO2) or nmol (CH4)
                mutate(
                    CO2_umol_m2 = ffi_ppm_to_umol(CO2, 
                                               volume = this_vol,
                                               temp = this_tair,
                                               atm = this_pressure) / COLLAR_AREA,
                    CH4_nmol_m2 = ffi_ppb_to_nmol(CH4, 
                                               volume = this_vol,
                                               temp = this_tair,
                                               atm = this_pressure) / COLLAR_AREA
                ) ->
                this_7810data
            
        })
        
        if(nrow(this_7810data) == 0) {
            message("\tno 7810 data available at ", this_start)
            log_row(metadata_row = this_mdrow,
                    date = d, plot = this_plot, 
                    time_start = as.character(this_start),
                    offset = this_offset, n_obs = 0,
                    co2_flux_success = NA, ch4_flux_success = NA,
                    note = "No 7810 data")
            #log_row(date = md_this_offsets$)
            next
        }
        
        # Compute fluxes. Because of the process used in 2-Clock_Offsets.R,
        # we set don't use deadband as that's already been accounted for
        md_this_offsets$wx_tair[msmt] <- this_tair
        co2f <- ffi_compute_fluxes(this_7810data,
                                   group_column = NULL, 
                                   time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                                   gas_column = "CO2_umol_m2")
        co2_success <- exists("co2f") & !is.na(co2f$lin_flux.estimate)
        success_count <- success_count + co2_success
        colnames(co2f) <- paste0("co2_", colnames(co2f))
        co2_fluxes[[msmt]] <- co2f
        
        ch4f <- ffi_compute_fluxes(this_7810data,
                                   group_column = NULL, 
                                   time_column = "TIMESTAMP", 
                                   gas_column = "CH4_nmol_m2")
        ch4_success <- exists("ch4f") & !is.na(ch4f$lin_flux.estimate)
        colnames(ch4f) <- paste0("ch4_", colnames(ch4f))
        ch4_fluxes[[msmt]] <- ch4f
        
        log_row(metadata_row = this_mdrow,
                date = d, plot = this_plot, 
                time_start = as.character(this_start), 
                offset = this_offset, 
                n_obs = nrow(this_7810data),
                co2_flux_success = co2_success, 
                ch4_flux_success = ch4_success)
        
        rm(co2f, ch4f)
    } # for msmt
    
    bind_rows(co2_fluxes) |> 
        bind_cols(bind_rows(ch4_fluxes)) |> 
        mutate(metadata_row = i) ->
        fluxes
    message("\tcombining and saving ", nrow(fluxes), " fluxes")
    
    write_parquet(fluxes, file.path(TEMP_FLUX_DIR, paste0(gsub("-", "", d), ".parquet")))
    
    log_date(date = d, 
             n_metadata_rows = nrow(md_this),
             n_obs = nrow(li7810dat), 
             offsets_available = TRUE, 
             n_flux_success = success_count)
} # for i

```
